title: Move task-sync exchange to a dedicated orphan data branch and data worktree, off the code branch
outcome: Move task-sync exchange to a dedicated orphan data branch and data worktree, off the code branch
acceptance: Task-sync export, import and merge read and write `.engram/` data only in a dedicated data worktree on one long-lived orphan data branch per project; no code-branch commit, code worktree or code source_id contains or changes because of exported task or evidence data.

Concurrent hosts exchange through fetch, Engram's merge and a fast-forward commit on the data branch; a rejected push is resolved without force, rebase or history rewrite, shown by a behavior test with two local clones of a bare remote under target/.

The existing ledger, reducer, proportional delta, origin enrollment and evidence pack formats are reused unchanged in meaning; the binding targets the data branch, Git delta reading uses the data branch's commits, and the code no longer implements or requires the linked-worktree sparse-checkout contract; bringing the remaining repository design docs in line is tracked by w-5f56184f72c1.
docs/features/git-task-sync.md, task-planning-text.md, spec.md and shipped.md describe the data-branch design, and the w-09c87a312e95 evidence design is noted as living on the data branch.

completion.summary: Moved task-sync task text and evidence exchange to a dedicated orphan data branch and MAIN/.engram-data worktree, preserving host-local authority and existing ledger/reducer/evidence formats. Landed exact AACB and completed installed release cutover on all six Central and both DL560 live stores; actual repair/readiness receipts and installed pins qualified. Independent evaluation e2af549062724a0790bf69ad99153f85 remains fresh 4/4 at revision49. Wider design-document cleanup remains w-5f56184f72c1.
